detail.longDescription: Serverless OS Web Push Notifications Serverless Native OS Web Push in ETHOS 🔔 Never miss a message from your website visitors or peers! ETHOS now uses the W3C Web Push VAPID protocol and Service Workers for OS-native background notifications. Zero central servers and zero plaintext in transit. Notifications trigger directly across macOS, Windows, Android, and iOS PWA! # PWA # WebPush # PrivacyFirst # OpenSource # E2EE
